name: bitmovin-encoding-vod
description: Teach Claude how to create and start a Bitmovin VOD encoding (H.264 per-title, H.264 fixed ladder, AV1 per-title for UGC, or H.264 hardware-accelerated sports clips) end-to-end via the Encoding Templates API and the Bitmovin Python SDK. Covers input/output handling, parameter gathering, template rendering, schema validation, and waiting for FINISHED.
